name: Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
description: Introduction to connected, automated, and software-defined vehicles (CAV–SDV); vehicle system architecture and dynamics; perception and sensor fusion for cooperative awareness; V2X communication technologies – cooperative driving and maneuver coordination; software-defined vehicle architecture – AUTOSAR adaptive, middleware, OTA updates; functional safety and cybersecurity; artificial intelligence for perception and cooperative decision-making; digital twin and simulation frameworks for testing and validation; Powertrain and energy management integration in SDVs; human–machine interface, system-of-systems reliability, and emerging standards for connected mobility.
